$comment: Governed vocabulary for the fixture world (seed utah-water-fixture-v1). Flow, stage and equipment are distinct dimensions and are never silently converted into one another (technical specification, Numerical and temporal rules). Only an authorized steward creates or retires vocabulary terms; used terms cannot be deleted in a way that breaks historical records (FR-012).

observedProperties.name: Discharge
observedProperties.description: Volumetric flow rate. Distinct from stage and storage; never summed with them.

observedProperties.name: Stage
observedProperties.description: Water surface elevation above a local datum.

observedProperties.name: Battery voltage
observedProperties.description: Station supply voltage. Internal diagnostic property, not a water measurement.

units.name: cubic feet per second
units.description: Acre-feet = integrated cubic feet / 43560 for a rate representative of its interval.

qualifiers.name: Ice affected
qualifiers.description: Value influenced by ice; used when the measurement is retained with a caveat rather than excluded.

qualifiers.name: Interpolated
qualifiers.description: Value estimated between bracketing readings under a declared method; never applied across an unbounded gap.

processingLevels.name: Raw
processingLevels.description: Original observation exactly as received. Immutable; corrections append revisions.

processingLevels.name: Provisional
processingLevels.description: Screened but not reviewed; still subject to change.

processingLevels.name: Reviewed
processingLevels.description: Accepted through a documented review workflow. Reviewed does not imply public.

processingLevels.name: Best available
processingLevels.description: Current best value for the logical observation; remains correctable after year end.
